_0.Text: You can obtain items by scanning a DigiEgg with any remaining data

_1.Text: You can freely enter the Digital World after you have been officially acknowledged as a member

_2.Text: Tip Conversations can be turned on or off from the Interface Setup in the Options window.

_3.Text: Mercenary Digimon are available when you get a Mercenary DigiEgg.

_4.Text: You can level up a skill with skill points, but check to see what you can do when you get skill points

_5.Text: All kinds of DigiEgg can be returned for refund.

_6.Text: The HP gauge can be set to be viewed in the Interface Setup in the Options window.

_7.Text: Chief Digimon tend to attack first, so make sure not to let yourself get surrounded by them.

_8.Text: You need to be an official member of Dats Center to use the D-terminal to go to the Digital World.

_9.Text: The default shortcut for the Digimon Information window is [ X ].

_10.Text: The default shortcut for the Tamer Information window is [ C ].

_11.Text: Tamers and Digimon have certain attractions to each other. You can check the attractions in the Tamer Information window.

_12.Text: The higher the attraction is to the Digimon, the more capabilities from its Tamer will be transferred to the Digimon, and this will make it stronger.

_13.Text: The default shortcut for the Quest Log window is [ L ].

_14.Text: You can set your own shortcut in Options > Shortcut Setup menu.

_15.Text: When the Digimon develops to level 11, Maturity Development can be applied.

_16.Text: Foods cannot be consumed in the middle of a battle, but just one of them before or after a battle will restore the HP of both the Digimon and the Tamer.

_17.Text: If you are not sure about the details of your current quest, press [ L ], the default shortcut for the Quest Log, and check what you have to do.

_18.Text: Basically, vaccines are weak against data, which is weak against a virus, and a virus is weak against vaccine. So make sure to check the attributes on the Target window before attacking.

_19.Text: You can find Mercenary DigiEgg by defeating the corresponding Digimon in the field.

_20.Text: [Miki] is responsible for collecting cracked DigiEggs.

_21.Text: You need related data items to hatch Mercenary DigiEgg. Scan DigiEgg to find the data items.

_22.Text: Insert data 3 times successfully to hatch a Mercenary DigiEgg. But inserting data 4 or 5 times will give you a bigger Mercenary Digimon.

_23.Text: Be careful when hatching a Mercenary DigiEgg because unsuccessful data insertion may destroy it.

_24.Text: Scan DigiEgg to get various items. For example, an HP restoring item, Tamer parts, Mercenary DigiEgg, data items to hatch the eggs, and so on.

_25.Text: Some items are available only by scanning DigiEgg. In particular, the data items required for hatching Mercenaries cannot be found otherwise.

_26.Text: The default shortcut for the Inventory window is [ I ].

_27.Text: Digimon use up Tamers' DS to digivolve and live on. The higher the Tamer's level is, the longer the Digimon will remain digivolved.

_28.Text: You can turn the Quest Notice function on or off in the Quest Log window.

_29.Text: Currencies are T - Tera, M- Mega and B - Bit.

_30.Text: Press ? to watch the tutorial video again.

_31.Text: Get a cracked DigiEgg, and return it to the NPC who scans and collects DigiEgg, for refund.

_32.Text: If your system is not up to date and you have problems with gameplay, use the "Simple Character Rendering" option under Options > Interface.

_33.Text: Press Ctrl + Z to hide the interface and take cooler screenshots.

_34.Text: Press Print Screen to take a screenshot.

_35.Text: While using the NPC search function, this search function will be automatically cancelled if you use [Follow] command or if you get too far away from the Digimon you're searching for.

_36.Text: Pay close attention to the Tamer's Fatigue Level. Tired Tamers attack and move more slowly than usual.

_37.Text: Fatigue Level is active when you are in the field, but it will be restored when you are back in town.

_38.Text: Click the Find NPC button in the Mini Map if you don't know where an NPC is.

_39.Text: When the Tamer level is higher than 5 and Digimon level is higher than 11, death will mean losing XP, so be careful when you are in a battle.

_40.Text: The default shortcut for the Friends List window is [ F ].

_41.Text: Blocking will literally block all messages, including Whispers.

_42.Text: Cash items that are purchased on the website can be found in the Cash Warehouse in the game.

_43.Text: Check the Menu bar in the lower righthand corner to open the Cash Shop.

_44.Text: Open the Cash Shop and press "Refresh" to view what you have purchased.

_45.Text: There are two types of quests - a main quest and a sub-quest. You have to complete main quests in order to progress in the game.

_46.Text: Press Alt + click on the name of the other Tamer in the Chat window to send a Whisper directly.

_47.Text: If you don't know where the NPC is located, or where to go on the map, simply click on the name to view the details.

_48.Text: Click the icon in the lower lefthand corner to turn off the Search function.

_49.Text: Click on an action in a chat window to make the Tamer perform certain actions. Left click to select the action, and right click to perform it.

_50.Text: It is basic manners to first ask the other user's interest before a trade or a party request.

_51.Text: In the case of trading items acquired through actions that violate operating policies, there may be disadvantages to both sides of the transaction. Please be careful!
